note: A complete final partition of this market's confirmed identity census: every identity in exactly one final state, and exactly one next action for every identity that is not terminal. Final states are BLOCKERS -- what the identity is waiting on -- not verdicts about the property. Nothing here publishes, excludes, or routes anything; it joins committed authority and states what remains. An unresolved identity is UNKNOWN and never a refusal.

evidence_determination.restated_from: PTF-CLEVELAND-WORK-BROWSER-INTEGRATION-001 (6f9ba1d). The handback's twenty-seven files hash byte-identical to the hashes that commit recorded, so its determination is carried forward unchanged rather than re-derived into a second ledger.

final_state_meanings.PUBLISHED_PET_FRIENDLY: A pet policy passed the membrane and the publication guard on this property's own captured page, and the hotel has a public route.
final_state_meanings.VERIFIED_NO_PETS: A refusal was captured with a citable artifact and source_hash; the property is excluded and generates no route.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_POLICY_ARTIFACT: The policy WORDING is known but no artifact of the surface it was read from exists. Every publication route requires a sha256 of the page (or of an operator screenshot of the page); a hash of a transcription binds the typing, not the page.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_POLICY_OBSERVATION: The route is sound and the page served its content, but no pet policy has ever been observed on it. UNKNOWN, never a refusal.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_ATTENDED_CAPTURE: The policy exists on the property's own surface but behind a click, an accordion, a modal, or client-side rendering that a static fetch cannot reach. An attended browser is the lawful route, not a bypass.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_ROUTING_REPLACEMENT: The URL on record is provably not this property's page -- dead, a different business, or a brand surface that refused to serve it. Policy work cannot start until the route is replaced.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_ROUTING_REVIEW: A routing proposal exists whose destination cannot be confirmed first-party because the brand is bot-walled. It is HELD: neither accepted on a transcription's word nor discarded.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_OFFICIAL_URL: No official URL has ever been found for this identity. The census confirms the property exists; nothing says where its page is.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_PROPERTY_LEVEL_URL: Only a brand index, brand-locator, or city-level URL is bound. Such a URL is property-specific for nobody and cannot back a policy fact.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_CONTRADICTION_RESOLUTION: The evidence conflicts with itself. M8 forbids this layer from picking a winner; both surfaces must be captured for approval_resolution.
final_state_meanings.AWAITING_CENSUS_REVIEW: The queued identity itself is in question -- not lodging, or rebranded so that the name and phone on record are stale. Census work, not policy work.
final_state_meanings.ACCESS_BLOCKED: An anti-bot or access-control wall stands between us and the property's own page and there is no lawful automated path. Never retried programmatically, never bypassed.

ACCESS_BLOCKED.why: 001 filed a row as ACCESS_BLOCKED whenever the surface it reached refused to render -- including when that surface was a PROPOSED destination rather than the property's own route. Comfort Suites Hartville, InterContinental Suites Cleveland and Extended Stay America Premier Suites waited on a routing replacement until PTF-CLEVELAND-ROUTING-REPAIR-001 bound working property pages for all three, which leaves them awaiting a policy observation. ACCESS_BLOCKED here keeps only identities with no lawful automated path to the property's own page at all.

CONTRADICTION.why: Kept whole. M8 forbids this layer from preferring one half of conflicting evidence.

EVIDENCE_CANDIDATE_AWAITING_ACCEPTED_ART.why: Hyatt Place Cleveland/Westlake/Crocker Park carries the sixteenth, unadjudicated routing proposal, and its transcription was read from the proposed page rather than from the route on record -- so routing is the question that comes first for it. Best Western Plus North Canton splits the same way as of PTF-CLEVELAND-ROUTING-REPAIR-001: bestwestern.com refuses to serve its property page, so its transcribed policy has no route to be re-anchored against until routing is repaired.

IDENTITY_ONLY.why: A page that rendered and stated no pet policy is waiting on an observation, not on an artifact. UNKNOWN, never a refusal.

IDENTITY_OR_ROUTING_CORRECTED_POLICY_UNR.why: Routing is not publication. The corrected route means the next capture has somewhere real to look, and the pet policy is still unobserved.

MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.why: 'A human must look' is not a blocker -- it is true of every unresolved row. Split by what the human is actually being asked to do: settle conflicting evidence, find a working URL, or decide whether the identity belongs in a hotel census.

OTHER_UNRESOLVED.why: The eight rejected routing proposals leave different blockers behind, because a rejected proposal returns the identity to whatever its RECORDED route already left unanswered. Two of 001's own next actions for them open with 'No routing action'.

SELECTOR_OR_SURFACE_GAP.why: An IHG FAQ question with no answer, a blank policy modal and a client-side-rendered page are one blocker: the words exist on the property's own surface and a static fetch cannot reach them.

routing_proposals_in_package.note: The package manifest counts routing proposals by CLASSIFICATION and reports 14 (+1 in batch 2). Sixteen rows actually carry a populated proposed replacement URL. The sixteenth is Hyatt Place Cleveland/Westlake/Crocker Park, a batch-2 row whose routing_correction_status is ROUTING_REVIEW_NEEDED_NOT_AUTHORITY but whose final_classification is EVIDENCE_SUCCESS_OFFICIAL_ROUTE_RECOVERED, so a classification-keyed adjudication never saw it. HELD as AWAITING_ROUTING_REVIEW: hyatt.com may not be probed, so no first-party confirmation of the destination is available.
